create_agent_modal_opened_on_click.critical_behavioural_observation: Corti Console Agent create flow accepts ONLY the name on first step. All other fields (description, systemPrompt, agentType, experts[], mcpServers[]) are configured AFTER creation on the Agent detail page. This is the 'create-then-customize' UX pattern.
create_agent_modal_opened_on_click.contrast_with_public_api_docs: Public docs §2.2 (A1B-AE.1) describes POST /agents with full body {name, description, agentType, systemPrompt, experts[], mcpServers[]}. Console UX does NOT expose this full form. The underlying API call the Console makes still POSTs the full body — but the Console drives a specific UX workflow (name first → customize later) rather than a single big form.
create_agent_modal_opened_on_click.icoder_implication: iCoDer A1B-AE.4 Agent CRUD can implement EITHER pattern. Recommendation: keep the existing full-form POST /api/v1/agents (matches public API contract); ADD a Console-style 'quick create' endpoint that accepts name-only and returns an ID for subsequent customization. Both patterns are Corti-compatible.

use_a_template_panel.icoder_implication: iCoDer's Pack filesystem (29 canonical Packs) is the analogue. The 'Use a template' flow = iCoDer's existing 'Clone Preset' flow (POST /api/icoder/agents/{id}/clone per A1B-AE.1 §3 of icoder_agents_hub.py).

implications_for_icoder_a1b_ae_3: iCoDer Expert Registry model design: CONFIRMED that Experts are NOT managed via a top-level Console UI. They are managed INSIDE the Agent detail page. iCoDer's existing `experts` table + `/api/v1/experts` endpoints is therefore STRICTLY MORE NORMALISED than Corti. Keep the iCoDer pattern.

iCoDer Expert model fields to add (A1B-AE.3 scope): canonical_key (snake_case), origin (CLEAN_ROOM_PUBLIC | REVERSE_ENGINEERED | ICODER_INTERNAL | PACK_DECLARED), corti_alignment (per A1B-AE.2 §3.3), pack_dir (link back to A1B-AE.2 catalog), provenance metadata per Charter Amendment 1 §7.
iCoDer Expert API: keep existing list/get/create endpoints; ADD a `provenance` field on responses so consumers can tell which tier each Expert came from.
iCoDer A1B-AE.4 should add a 'quick-create' endpoint POST /api/v1/agents/quick {name} returning an ID, matching Corti Console's pattern. Out of A1B-AE.3 scope.
